evidence.detail: PvpTrackerSidebarPanel.a(int,String,String,String,String) constructs this Runnable and schedules it with EventQueue.invokeLater.
The task targets the label groups created immediately under the exact 'Most Recent 1v1 Fight' section, with selector 1 choosing one participant column and the alternate selector choosing the other.
run() updates outcome/opponent text and icon plus Correct overheads, Spell casts and Damage Dealt labels; it switches skull/user icon based on whether the supplied outcome text contains 'Died)'.

evidence.detail: R357 LauncherSidePanel installs rs/gui/c/a as the exact tab labeled 'PvP Tracker' with the fixed side-panel dimensions.

The panel renders exact PvP statistics text including 'Type ::pvptracker to view overlay in-game', 'Most Recent 1v1 Fight', 'Previous 1v1 Fight', 'Correct overheads', 'Spell casts' and 'Damage Dealt'.
Its two public update methods schedule rs/gui/c/b and rs/gui/c/c on EventQueue, updating the most-recent and previous fight participant/stat label groups respectively.
